verses.en: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.pt: E quanto aos dons espirituais, irmãos, não quero que sejais ignorantes.
verses.en_web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
verses.en_bbe: But about the things of the spirit, my brothers, it is not right for you to be without teaching.

verses.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
verses.pt: Vós sabeis que éreis gentios, vós vos desviáveis para os ídolos mudos, conforme éreis guiados.
verses.en_web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
verses.en_bbe: You are conscious that when you were Gentiles, in whatever way you were guided, you went after images without voice or power.

verses.en: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Por isso eu vos deixo claro que ninguém que fala pelo Espírito de Deus chama a Jesus de maldito; e ninguém pode dizer que Jesus é o Senhor, a não ser pelo Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: So it is my desire for you to be clear about this; that no one is able to say by the Spirit of God that Jesus is cursed; and no one is able to say that Jesus is Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.pt: E há variedade de dons, mas o Espírito é o mesmo.
verses.en_web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Now there are different qualities given to men, but the same Spirit.

verses.en: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
verses.pt: E há variedade de trabalhos na Igreja,mas o Senhor é o mesmo.
verses.en_web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
verses.en_bbe: And there are different sorts of servants, but the same Lord.

verses.en: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
verses.pt: E há variedade de operações, mas é o mesmo Deus que opera tudo em todos.
verses.en_web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
verses.en_bbe: And there are different operations, but the same God, who is working all things in all.

verses.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.pt: Mas a cada um é dada a manifestação do Espírito, para o que for conveniente.
verses.en_web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
verses.en_bbe: But to every man some form of the Spirit's working is given for the common good.

verses.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
verses.pt: Porque a um é dada, pelo Espírito, palavra de sabedoria; e a outro palavra de conhecimento, pelo mesmo Espírito.
verses.en_web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;
verses.en_bbe: For to one are given words of wisdom through the Spirit; and to another words of knowledge through the same Spirit:

verses.en: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
verses.pt: e a outro fé pelo mesmo Espírito; e a outro dons de curas, pelo mesmo Espírito.
verses.en_web: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
verses.en_bbe: To another faith in the same Spirit; and to another the power of taking away disease, by the one Spirit;

verses.en: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.pt: E a outro operações de milagres; e a outro profecia; e a outro o dom de discernir aos espíritos; e a outro variedade de línguas; e a outro interpretação de línguas.
verses.en_web: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.
verses.en_bbe: And to another the power of working wonders; and to another the prophet's word; and to another the power of testing spirits; to another different sorts of tongues; and to another the power of making clear the sense of the tongues:

verses.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
verses.pt: Mas todas estas coisas quem opera é um e o mesmo Espírito, repartindo particularmente a cada um como quer.
verses.en_web: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
verses.en_bbe: But all these are the operations of the one and the same Spirit, giving to every man separately as his pleasure is.

verses.en: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
verses.pt: Porque assim como o corpo é um, e tem muitos membros, e todos os membros deste único corpo, sendo muitos, compõem um só corpo; assim também é Cristo.
verses.en_web: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For as the body is one, and has a number of parts, and all the parts make one body, so is Christ.

verses.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.pt: Porque também todos nós somos batizados em um só Espírito, para um só corpo, quer judeus, quer gregos, quer servos, quer livres; e para todos nós foi dado de beber um só Espírito.
verses.en_web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: For through the baptism of the one Spirit we were all formed into one body, Jews or Greeks, servants or free men, and were all made full of the same Spirit.

verses.en: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.pt: Porque também o corpo não é um só membro, mas muitos.
verses.en_web: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.en_bbe: For the body is not one part, but a number of parts.

verses.en: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.pt: Se o pé disser: Por eu não ser mão, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ele não é do corpo?
verses.en_web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
verses.en_bbe: If the foot says, Because I am not the hand, I am not a part of the body; it is no less a part of the body.

verses.en: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.pt: E se a orelha disser: Por eu não ser olho, não sou do corpo;Por isso, ela não é do corpo?
verses.en_web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
verses.en_bbe: And if the ear says, Because I am not the eye, I am not a part of the body; it is a part of the body all the same.

verses.en: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
verses.pt: Se todo o corpo fosse olho, onde estaria o ouvido? Se fosse todo ouvido, onde estaria o olfato?
verses.en_web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
verses.en_bbe: If all the body was an eye, where would be the hearing? if all was hearing, where would be the smelling?

verses.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
verses.pt: Mas agora Deus pôs os membros no corpo, a cada qual deles como ele quis.
verses.en_web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
verses.en_bbe: But now God has put every one of the parts in the body as it was pleasing to him.

verses.en: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
verses.pt: Porque se todos fossem um só membro, onde estaria o corpo?
verses.en_web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
verses.en_bbe: And if they were all one part, where would the body be?

verses.en: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
verses.pt: Mas há agora muitos membros, porém um só corpo.
verses.en_web: But now they are many members, but one body.
verses.en_bbe: But now they are all different parts, but one body.

verses.en: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.pt: E o olho não pode dizer à mão: Não tenho necessidade de ti;Nem a cabeça aos pés: Não tenho necessidade de vós;
verses.en_web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
verses.en_bbe: And the eye may not say to the hand, I have no need of you: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

verses.en: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
verses.pt: Antes até os membros do corpo que nos parecem ser os mais fracos, são muito mais necessários.
verses.en_web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
verses.en_bbe: No, those parts which seem to be feeble are the more necessary;

verses.en: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
verses.pt: E os que pensamos serem os menos honrados do corpo, a esses muito mais honramos; e os nossos mais desprezíveis têm muito mais respeito.
verses.en_web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;
verses.en_bbe: And to those parts of the body which seem to have less honour we give all the more honour; and to those parts of the body which are a cause of shame to us we give the greater respect;

verses.en: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
verses.pt: Porém os nosso mais respeitáveis não têm tanta necessidade; mas assim Deus juntou o corpo, dando muito mais honra ao que tinha falta dela.
verses.en_web: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
verses.en_bbe: But those parts of the body which are beautiful have no need of such care: and so the body has been joined together by God in such a way as to give more honour to those parts which had need of it;

verses.en: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
verses.pt: Para que não haja divisão no corpo, mas que os membros tenham igual cuidado uns com os outros.
verses.en_web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
verses.en_bbe: So that there might be no division in the body; but all the parts might have the same care for one another.

verses.en: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.pt: E seja que, caso um membro sofra, também os membros sofrem juntos; e caso um membro seja honrado, todos os membros se alegram juntos.
verses.en_web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.en_bbe: And if there is pain in one part of the body, all the parts will be feeling it; or if one part is honoured, all the parts will be glad.

verses.en: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
verses.pt: E vós sois o corpo de Cristo, e membros em particular.
verses.en_web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
verses.en_bbe: Now you are the body of Christ, and every one of you the separate parts of it.

verses.en: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
verses.pt: E Deus pôs a uns na Igreja: em primeiro lugar apóstolos, em segundo profetas, em terceiro mestres; depois milagres, dons de curas, socorros, lideranças, variedades de línguas.
verses.en_web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
verses.en_bbe: And God has put some in the church, first, Apostles; second, prophets; third, teachers; then those with wonder-working powers, then those with the power of taking away disease, helpers, wise guides, users of strange tongues.

verses.en: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
verses.pt: Por acaso são todos apóstolos? São todos profetas? São todos mestres? São todos com dons de milagres?
verses.en_web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
verses.en_bbe: Are all Apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? have all the power of working wonders?

verses.en: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.pt: Tem todos dons de curas? Falam todos várias línguas? Interpretam todos?
verses.en_web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
verses.en_bbe: Are all able to take away disease? have all the power of tongues? are all able to give their sense?

verses.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.pt: Porém desejai com zelo pelos melhores dons; e eu vos mostro um caminho ainda mais excelente.
verses.en_web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
verses.en_bbe: But let your desires be turned to the more important things given by the Spirit. And now I am pointing out to you an even better way.
